sources.title: Whisper 51 African Languages (ASR) - SALT Documentation
sources.snippet: SALT Models ASR Whisper 51 African Languages Overview ASR Whisper 51 African Languages is an adaptation of Whisper Large v3 that supports Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) for 51 languages widely spoken in Africa: English and French with African accents, Swahili, Afrikaans, Tswana, Kinyarwanda, Nigerian Pidgin, Luganda, Acholi, Lugbara, Ateso, Runyankole, Rutooro, Lumasaba, Lusoga, Rukiga ...
